title: Puzzle 15
desc: Slide the numbered tiles into order 1 to 15 on a 4x4 board with a random-walk shuffle that always solves; count moves, beat the clock and your best.

title: Peg Solitaire
desc: Jump pegs over their neighbours to clear the English cross board; finish with exactly one peg standing, with undo and a no-moves-left lose state.

title: Checkers
desc: Face the computer on an 8x8 board with forced jumps, forward-only men and king promotion; tap pieces or steer a cursor with the arrow keys.

title: Reversi
desc: Trap rival discs between two of yours to flip them; legal-move hints against an MCTS computer player on the classic 8x8 board.

title: Battleship
desc: Place your fleet, then trade single shots with an AI that hunts neighbouring squares after a hit; sink all four enemy ships before they sink yours.
